use: The reckoning, at the end of a fortnight
subject: A wide view of a District Officer's office on the deep verandah of his bungalow, seen from where he sits. The teak desk runs across the lower third of the frame, and the dark green leather blotter in the middle of it is completely BARE. On the desk: a brass inkwell and pen rest at the left, a handbell, a glass tumbler, a low wooden rack of rubber stamps with turned handles, a wire tray. Behind the desk, the room: a plastered wall with a large EMPTY picture frame hanging on it, its inside blank; a shelf of stacked files and ledgers tied with red tape; a punkah with its long cloth fringe across the top of the frame. To one side a wide arched opening onto the compound. Very late at night. The brass oil lamp turned low, throwing one small warm circle on the blotter and leaving the rest of the room in deep blue darkness. The wire tray is empty and the blotter swept clean. Beyond the arch, the compound in moonlight, the flame tree a black shape, one lamp burning far off in the town, and a great many stars.
